summary: Louisiana-Pacific Corporation filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to announce a routine quarterly dividend declaration. The Board declared a cash dividend of $0.30 per share, payable August 28, 2026, to stockholders of record as of August 14, 2026. The press release was attached as Exhibit 99.1. This is a standard recurring dividend disclosure with no special-situation aspects, such as a tender offer, activist campaign, or strategic transaction. The filing contains no unusual terms, no advisor involvement, and no structural changes. There is nothing to watch from a special-situation or risk-arbitrage perspective.
